jobs.prompt: Fix one review finding, tests added to tests/autopilot-integrate-clean.test.mjs. In tools/autopilot.mjs runIntegrateOutputPaths returns an empty list for normal go --scope runs, because the production run summaries (tools/brief.mjs loadRuns as wrapped in tools/swarm.mjs, and most journal run events) carry only integrable and counts, with no jobs and no manifest object; as a result autopilot itself and the triage integrate handler would raise a 'no declared output paths' owner blocker instead of integrating, and unattended auto-integration would stop. Fix: when the summary and the journal events give no output paths, read them from the run's own files under <root>/.swarm/runs/<runId>/ (state.json jobs[].outputs for jobs whose status is complete, and manifest.json jobs[].outputs as a second source; also child-run outputs of lead jobs), through an injectable reader (default reads the files; refuse symlinks, never throw: an unreadable file means no paths), validate that every path is relative, inside the project and without '..', and drop the rest. The empty-outputs refusal then fires only when the run folder also yields none. Add tests with a temp run folder shaped like a real production state.json (jobs array with id, status, outputs) and a manifest.json: paths are found from state.json, from manifest.json when state has none, a symlinked or unreadable state file gives none, paths with .. or absolute paths are dropped, and a run whose summary has only integrable and counts still integrates (no owner blocker) when the run folder has outputs. Keep every existing test passing (tests/autopilot-*.test.mjs, tests/needs-you-triage.test.mjs).
